message.content:
The question asks for resolutions that drive changes to spec 38.133. Resolutions reference CRs/Tdocs (rel_REFERENCES), and those CRs/Tdocs modify/affect specs. The ordering keys include meetingNumberInt, agendaNumber, sequence — resolutions connect to meetings and agenda items.

Let me build: Resolution -> REFERENCES -> CR/Tdoc -> MODIFIES/AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC/AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC -> Spec(38.133).

The ordering needs meetingNumberInt (via MADE_AT Meeting), agendaNumber (via RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO AgendaItem), sequence (Resolution.sequence).

```json
{"query":"SELECT DISTINCT r.resolutionId AS resolutionId FROM \"Resolution\" r JOIN rel_REFERENCES ref ON ref.src_id = r.node_id JOIN (SELECT src_id, dst_id FROM rel_MODIFIES UNION SELECT src_id, dst_id FROM rel_AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC UNION SELECT src_id, dst_id FROM rel_AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC) m ON m.src_id = ref.dst_id JOIN \"Spec\" s ON s.node_id = m.dst_id AND s.specNumber = '38.133' LEFT JOIN rel_MADE_AT ma ON ma.src_id = r.node_id LEFT JOIN \"Meeting\" mt ON mt.node_id = ma.dst_id LEFT JOIN rel_RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO rb ON rb.src_id = r.node_id LEFT JOIN \"AgendaItem\" ai ON ai.node_id = rb.dst_id ORDER BY mt.meetingNumberInt DESC, ai.agendaNumber ASC, r.sequence ASC LIMIT 10","abstain":false}
```
